lessons: Root cause is the environment, not the diff. The Check worktree .clutch/state/worktrees/mcp-dashboard-ux-parity has no node_modules, so dev.build_ui_bundle in dev.py:46 cannot find node_modules/.bin/esbuild and tests/integration/test_mcp_app_dashboard.py::test_dashboard_bundle fails. The other 17

The engine's worktree setup never makes the host's JS dev dependencies (esbuild) available in ticket worktrees. A human should fix that provisioning, or let the gate resolve esbuild from the main checkout, in clutch's workspace or git setup code. That code is outside this ticket's fence.

Implement passed only because it temporarily symlinked the main checkout's node_modules and then ran unlink before committing. Do not commit node_modules or edit dev.py: both are outside the fence and would not fix the cause.

test_dashboard_bundle and dev.build_ui_bundle exist on the base, so any ticket that runs this test in a fresh worktree will fail the same way. After the environment is fixed, rerun Check on the existing branch (commit 20eff574f) without changing the code.
